acquisition_method.evidence: The mass spectrometer was operated in the data-dependent mode to automatically switch between MS and MS/MS acquisition.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Trypsin without proline restriction enzyme option was used, with two allowed miscleavages.

ionization_type.evidence: equipped with a nanoelectrospray ion source (EasySpray/Thermo).

labeling.evidence: inferred: Label-free quantitation was set with a retention time alignment window of 3 minutes.

mass_analyzer.evidence: inferred: All experiments were performed on an Easy nLC1000 nano-LC system connected to a quadrupole–Orbitrap (QExactive) mass spectrometer (ThermoElectron, Bremen, Germany)
